finding: Laparoscopic cornuotomy with or without local methotrexate injection was a successful treatment for interstitial pregnancy, with a high rate of subsequent spontaneous intrauterine pregnancies and no cases of uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Three patients who delivered by cesarean section after laparoscopic cornuotomy showed no uterine dehiscence or thinning of the scar at the site of the earlier cornual incision and repair.
